basic_details.job_title: ICMR NIRDH Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: ICMR National Institute for Research in Digital Health (ICMR NIRDH) has announced 1 vacancy for the Consultant (Technical - Non-Medical) post on a contract basis under advertisement number 19 December 2025/Estt./237444. The initial engagement is for a period of one year, with a pay of Rs. 1,25,000. Candidates applying for the post must possess an M.Sc/B.Tech/B.E. in Biomedical Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics or equivalent degree. Eligible applicants can apply online by sending the application form in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of certificates via

how_to_apply: Fill out the application form in the prescribed format attached to the notification.
Attach self-attested copies of Date of Birth certificate, educational qualifications, and experience certificates.
Submit the completed application through the official Google form link before the closing date.
Note: Applications submitted by hand, through email, WhatsApp, ordinary dak, or couriers are not accepted.

rows.details: ICMR National Institute for Research in Digital Health (ICMR NIRDH)
Rs. 1,25,000/- per month (For retired Govt. Servant, remuneration is fixed as per Ministry of Finance OM No. 3-25/2020-EINA dated 09 Dec 2020)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualifications and age criteria specified by ICMR NIRDH: Essential Qualification & Experience: Professionals having proven competency and success in their area of specialization, with at least 10 years of post-qualification experience and possessing a minimum M.Sc/B.Tech/B.E. in Biomedical Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics or equivalent degree in relevant subjects. Note on Qualifications: PhD is considered as 4 years' experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree). MPH, M.Tech, ME, and M.Pharma are not considered as any experience. Alternative Eligibility for Retired Government Employees: Retired Government employees with requisite qualification who were in the regular Pay Level-10 and above and having at least 10 years experience in the required specialization can also apply. Age Limit: Minimum 40 years up to 70 years. Cut-off date for age limit is the last date for submission of applications.

faq.question: Q1. Is the ICMR NIRDH Consultant post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, extendable based on performance and project needs up to a total tenure of five years or the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable as per the guidelines of ICMR.

faq.question: Q3. Can retired government employees apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, retired government employees with requisite qualifications who were in regular Pay Level-10 and above and have at least 10 years of experience in the required specialization are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. Are persons already in regular time scale service under government departments eligible?
faq.answer: No, persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department or Organization are not eligible to apply.
